summary: Learn how to apply design thinking principles to project management with our comprehensive training course. Enhance your skills today!
lede: Design thinking for project management gives project professionals a structured way to investigate user needs before defining a solution. For project managers, business analysts, product owners and programme teams, the course develops practical skills in mapping stakeholders, framing problems from user evidence, testing solution assumptions, and translating validated findings into requirements and delivery priorities.
audienceIntro: This intermediate to advanced course is designed for professionals who already contribute to projects and need to apply design thinking to ambiguous requirements, stakeholder decisions, and value-focused delivery.
prerequisites: You should have experience contributing to or managing projects and be able to work with basic project artefacts such as a scope statement, schedule, risk register, stakeholder list, or requirements log. Bring a current project challenge if organizational confidentiality permits. You will use provided case data where a live project cannot be discussed. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted research synthesis and digital prototyping receive operational application and guided practice. The course does not provide technical engineering instruction or production software development.
